scenarios.title: Sacrificing a permanent of the offering type lets the spell be cast at instant speed for a reduced cost

setup.notes: Patron of the Akki costs {4}{R}{R} and has Goblin offering. Mons's Goblin Raiders is a {R} Goblin. It is B's turn and A holds priority in B's beginning of combat step.

decisions: A casts Patron of the Akki, choosing to pay the additional cost of sacrificing Mons's Goblin Raiders.
A pays the reduced cost {4}{R} with the five Mountains.
Both players pass; Patron of the Akki resolves.

variants.label: sacrifice_goblin
variants.expected: Casting Patron of the Akki is legal during B's turn and costs {4}{R}. Mons's Goblin Raiders moves to A's graveyard, all five Mountains are tapped and Patron of the Akki enters the battlefield under A's control.

variants.label: no_offering
variants.delta: A does not pay the offering cost.
variants.expected: Casting Patron of the Akki is not legal: it is a creature spell and it is not A's main phase with an empty stack, and the cost would be {4}{R}{R}.

variants.label: wrong_type
variants.delta: A tries to sacrifice Grizzly Bears (not a Goblin) as the offering instead of Mons's Goblin Raiders.
variants.expected: Casting Patron of the Akki by sacrificing Grizzly Bears is not legal because Grizzly Bears is not a Goblin; Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield and Patron of the Akki stays in hand.

scenarios.title: The sacrificed permanent's mana cost reduces the matching parts of the total cost, and excess colored mana reduces generic

setup.notes: Patron of the Akki costs {4}{R}{R}. Avian Changeling ({2}{W}) is a Goblin by changeling. Goblin Piker ({1}{R}) is a Goblin.

decisions: A casts Patron of the Akki, choosing to pay the additional cost of sacrificing Avian Changeling.
A pays the reduced cost with Mountains.
Both players pass; Patron of the Akki resolves.

variants.label: sacrifice_changeling
variants.expected: The cost after adjustment is {1}{R}{R}: the generic {2} reduces generic, and the excess {W} reduces one more generic. A taps three Mountains, two Mountains stay untapped, and Patron of the Akki enters the battlefield. Avian Changeling is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: sacrifice_piker
variants.delta: A sacrifices Goblin Piker instead of Avian Changeling.
variants.expected: The cost after adjustment is {3}{R}: the generic {1} reduces generic and the {R} reduces one of the {R}. A taps four Mountains and Patron of the Akki enters the battlefield. Goblin Piker is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: no_sacrifice
variants.delta: A does not pay the offering cost.
variants.expected: The cost is the full {4}{R}{R}, which is six mana; A controls only five Mountains, so casting Patron of the Akki is not legal.
